continuity.opening: Pinocchio returns to the empty room after Geppetto has been taken to prison.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio leaves for school carrying the primer Geppetto bought by selling his only warm coat.
continuity.next: Music from a travelling puppet theatre will test whether Pinocchio can honour that sacrifice.

learningObjective: Connect warning, choice, consequence, apology, and sacrifice using clear time clauses and emotional contrast.

beats.title: The Cricket's Warning
beats.purpose: Set freedom against the practical value of work, study, and advice.

beats.title: Anger and an Empty Cupboard
beats.purpose: Turn rejected advice into loneliness and immediate hunger.

beats.title: The Dinner That Escapes
beats.purpose: Use comic disappointment to make the warning feel true.

beats.title: A Cold and Hungry Night
beats.purpose: Move the adventure into rain, rejection, and exhausted regret.

beats.title: The Missing Feet
beats.purpose: Reveal the physical consequence and bring Geppetto home.

beats.title: Geppetto's Three Pears
beats.purpose: Show sacrifice becoming visible through hunger and gratitude.

beats.title: A Promise and New Feet
beats.purpose: Let hope return while keeping the gap between promises and action visible.

beats.title: The Coat Becomes a Book
beats.purpose: End with Geppetto's quiet sacrifice and the next test already approaching.
